_comment: Who may sign what. Governance-protected: change it only in a chore(SDD) commit reviewed by the code owners.
approvalChannel: terminal = sign-offs are made with node sdd/scripts/approve.mjs and committed alone (works with any git host and any CI; the default);
github   = sign-offs are pull-request comments (/approve-plan F04) recorded by GitHub Actions (public GitHub, or GitHub Enterprise with Actions);
both     = either, for a short migration only.
people: the key is the person's GitHub login (used on the github channel); email is their git user.email (used on the terminal channel and by the pipeline check).
Replace every REPLACE_ME_ entry. Pipelines read this file from the target branch, so a change cannot approve itself.
Who signs plans and phases depends on each feature's risk tier: see sdd/governance/policy.json. decisions below cover the rest.
rules.trainingMode: true lets one person hold every role, for a solo training repository only. Never in a real repository.
